title: Negative Token Merging: Image-based Adversarial Feature Guidance

bias_targets.methodology: Using the FairFace classifier to detect race in generated human images and calculating an Entropy-Score to measure the diversity and spread of outputs across racial subcategories to evaluate mode collapse and homogenization.
Using the FairFace classifier to detect gender in generated human images and calculating an Entropy-Score to measure the diversity and spread of outputs across gender subcategories.
Using the FairFace classifier to detect age in generated human images and calculating an Entropy-Score to measure the diversity and representation of different age groups in the generated outputs.
